name: Sicilian Najdorf — English Attack
description: The most deeply analyzed opening in chess. After 5...a6, Black keeps all options open and prevents Nb5. White responds with the classical 6.Bg5 line — pinning the Nf6 and building pressure before Black can equalize. After 8.Qf3 Qc7, the battle lines are drawn for a full-board war.

lines.name: Najdorf Variation — 6.Bg5 Main Line
lines.description: White pins the Nf6 with Bg5 and builds a powerful center with f4. After 7.f4 Be7 8.Qf3 Qc7, both sides have declared their intentions — White attacks on the kingside, Black seeks counterplay on the queenside. This is the sharpest and most theoretically rich battleground in all of chess.
